description: Price of a Murnau VFX node job (the paid AI nodes of the Murnau editor: outpaint, relight, crowd-fill, person-maske, freistellen, video-denoise, video-extend …) — free, nothing is booked. The same server function the editor's price check and the actual booking use. Without session_id/media_id the price is computed from dauer_s/breite/hoehe/fps; with them, from the real media of that session. Name the price to the person and only start lab_murnau_vfx_auftrag after their yes.

params.description: Node parameters that change the price (e.g. upscale_factor)

task.description: Murnau VFX task, e.g. relight, outpaint, person-maske, video-denoise
